rows.question: Paige raised 7 goldfish and 12 catfish in the pond but stray cats loved eating them. Now she has 15 left. How many fishes disappeared?

There were 106 dollars in Olivia's wallet. After she visited a supermarket and a showroom there were 26 dollars left. If she spent 49 dollars at the showroom How much did she spend at the supermarket?
Ed had 10 more marbles than Doug. Doug lost 11 of his marbles at the playground. If Ed had 45 marbles How many more marbles did Ed have than Doug then?
An industrial machine made 9 shirts yesterday and 44 shirts today. It can make 3 shirts a minute. How many minutes did the machine work yesterday?
The ring toss game at the carnival made the same amount of money each day. In total in 5 days they earned 165 dollars. How much did they make per day?
There were 12 people on the bus. At the next stop 4 more people got on the bus. Each bus can not have more than 36 people. How many people are there on the bus now?
Paco had 9 sweet cookies and 6 salty cookies. He ate 36 sweet cookies and 3 salty cookies. How many salty cookies did Paco have left?
A book has 3 chapters. The first chapter is 66 pages long the second chapter is 35 pages long and the third chapter is 24 pages long. How many pages does the book have altogether?
The Razorback t-shirt shop made $ 51 dollars from selling 3 t-shirt during the Arkansas and Texas tech game they. What is the cost of each t-shirt?
Robin's hair was 16 inches long. He cut off 11 inches. Then it again grew by 12 inches. How long is his hair now?
Lucy went to the grocery store. She bought 10 packs of cookie and 4 packs of cake. How many more packs of cookie did she buy over cake?

Mary is baking a cake. The recipe calls for 10 cups of flour 2 cups of sugar and 80 cups of salt. She already put in 7 cups of flour. How many more cups of flour than cups of sugar does she need to add now?
There are some baskets of peaches. Each basket has 4 red peaches and 3 green peaches. If there are a total of 7 peaches in all baskets How many baskets of peaches are there?
Nell collects baseball cards. She had 566 cards while Jeff had 234 cards. She gave some of her cards to Jeff and now has 535 cards left. How many cards does Jeff have now?
At the stop 8 more people got on the train. Initially there were 11 people on the train. How many people are there on the train now?
5 red peaches and 11 green peaches are in the basket. How many more green peaches than red peaches are in the basket?
3 birds were sitting on the fence. 2 more birds and 6 more storks came to join them. How many more storks than birds are sitting on the fence?

Next on his checklist is wax to stick the feathers together and colors to paint them. He needs a total of 49 g of colors to paint them. If the feathers require 288 g of wax and right now he just needs 260 g How many grams of wax does he already have?
Baker made 155 cakes. If his friend bought 140 cakes from him How many cakes would baker still have?
A grocery store had 22 bottles of regular soda and 61 bottles of diet soda. How many more bottles of diet soda than regular soda did they have?
Ryan learns english and chinese for 7 days. Every day he spends 4 hours on learning english and 5 hours on learning chinese. How many hours does he spend on learning english and chinese in all?
Jessie weighed 114 kilograms. After she started to go jogging everyday she lost 50 kilograms in the first week and 60 kilograms in the second week. How much does she weigh now?
The Ferris wheel in paradise park has 3 small seats and 7 large seats. Each small seat can hold 16 people and large seat can hold 12 people. How many people can ride the Ferris wheel on large seats?
Bobby ate 17 pieces of candy. Then he ate 15 more. If he initially had 36 pieces of candy How many pieces of candy does he still have left?
They decided to hold the party in their backyard. They have 12 sets of tables and each set has 14 chairs. There are also 6 chairs extra. How many chairs do they have for the guests?
Adam has 10 apples. Jackie has 2 apples. How many more apples does Adam have than Jackie?
Jake has 7 fewer peaches than Steven and 9 more peaches than Jill. Steven has 16 peaches. How many peaches does Jake have?
White t - shirts can be purchased in packages of 13. If mom buys 39 white t - shirts How many packages will she have?

Julia played tag with 19 kids on monday. She played tag with 18 kids on tuesday. She spent a total of 38 hours to play tag on both days. How many more kids did she play with on monday than on tuesday?
3 birds and 4 storks were sitting on the fence. 6 more storks came to join them. How many birds and storks are sitting on the fence?
There are 11 baskets of peaches. Each basket has 10 red peaches and 18 green peaches. How many peaches are in the baskets altogether?

Paul got a box of 457 erasers and 617 crayons for his birthday. At the end of the school year he only had 523 crayons left while not having lost a single eraser. How many more crayons than erasers did he have left?
Brenda's mother made cookies for 5. She prepared 22 cookies but had to throw away 17 cookies. If each of them had the same number of cookies How many did each of them have?
A waiter had 12 customers. While 15 customers left he got 14 new customers. How many customers does he still have?
Ed had 6 more marbles than Doug. Doug lost 7 of his marbles at the playground. If Ed had 22 marbles How many marbles does Doug have now?
At the arcade Dave had won 18 tickets. If he used 5 to buy some toys and 11 more to buy some clothes How many tickets did Dave have left?
A mailman has to give 32 pieces of junk mail to each of the 55 blocks. If he gives 8 mails to each house in a block How many houses are there in a block?
Paco had 41 cookies. He gave 9 cookies to his friend and ate 18 cookies. How many more cookies did he eat than those he gave to his friend?

Jessie weighed 92 kilograms. After she started to go jogging everyday she lost 56 kilograms in the first week and 99 kilograms in the second week. How much did she weigh after the first week of jogging?
Melissa scored a total of 21 points playing some games. Is she scored 7 points in each game. How many games did she play?
Rachel had to complete 10 pages of math homework. If she had to complete 3 more pages of reading homework than math homework How many pages did she have to complete in all?

There were 15 roses in the vase. Jessica threw away 33 roses from the vase and cut some more new roses from her flower garden to put in the vase. There are now 17 roses in the vase. How many more roses did she cut than those she threw away?
After making some pies, chef had 2 apples left. Initially he had 43 apples How many apples did he use?
If the cave is 919 feet deep and they need to travel 1307 feet How far is the end of the cave?

36 children were riding on the bus. At the bus stop 68 children got off the bus while some more got on the bus. Then there were 12 children altogether on the bus. How many more children got off the bus than those that got on?

Mary is baking a cake. The recipe calls for 3 cups of sugar and 10 cups of flour. She already put in some cups of flour. If she still needs 5 more cups of flour than sugar How many cups of flour did she put in?
There are 20 different books in the ' crazy silly school ' series. If you are yet to read 5 of the books How many books have you already read?

There are 8 different books and 10 different movies in the ' crazy silly school ' series. If you read 19 of the books and watched 61 of the movies How many more movies than books are there in the ' crazy silly school ' series?
7 red peaches, 15 yellow peaches and 8 green peaches are in the basket. How many peaches are in the basket?
